note: rgb() and hsl() instead of hex
css: .tile--cool-500 { background: rgb(107 114 128) !important; } .tile--cool-400 { background: hsl(218 11% 65%) !important; } .text-primary { color: rgb(16, 24, 40) !important; }

note: swatches in a grid with space-between instead of flexbox
css: .swatches { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 48px); justify-content: space-between; }
